blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The University of the Philippines (UP) on Tuesday once more demanded for the release of the students who were arrested during a rally at the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits, as well as the removal of checkpoints inside the camps. The UP System Administration in a statement expressed that it “supports the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits and the necessary security measures for leaders and delegates around the world.” However, it raised concern over the arrest of more than 200 individuals, including students, during a demonstration in Barangay Sucat, Muntinlupa after tensions escalated between rallyists and […]...
